header.title: Developer tooling and open-source releases - Oct 14, 2026

items.text: Sample runtime 4.2 adds a built-in test runner.
items.quote: The new test runner ships enabled by default

items.text: Example tools 9.1 removes the deprecated configuration loader.
Demo language 3.0 stabilises the pattern matching syntax.
items.quote: pattern matching is now a stable feature

items.text: The Example editor team says extension start-up is now twice as fast.
Sample package registry now requires provenance statements for new packages.
Taken together, the sources suggest release cadences are shortening across runtimes and build tools.
A Demo build tool maintainer expects incremental builds to double in speed.
Demo build tool 2.8 changes the default cache location.
items.quote: the cache now lives under the user cache directory

items.text: Example tools announced a hosted preview of its dependency graph viewer.
Several projects are moving test tooling into the runtime itself, which may reduce separate test dependencies.
Demo language blog documents a new formatting default for imports.
Example editor news suggests a settings sync overhaul is planned for next quarter.
